description: Fermion Research Phonon-2 English ASR using the shared Parakeet implementation, with native hotwords and phrase-based streaming.

request.name: return_timestamps
request.description: Accepted for CLI --words-out compatibility. Word timestamps are always returned, including when false or omitted.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum TDT generated tokens; 0 or omitted uses the model-derived limit.

request.name: keep_language_tags
request.description: Keep language tag tokens in decoded text; default false.

request.name: audio_chunk_mode
request.description: Offline audio chunking mode. fixed selects overlapping long-form windows regardless of offline_mode; vad uses the configured VAD model (Silero by default) to skip silence; auto follows offline_mode. Offline input is downmixed and resampled as needed.

request.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
request.description: VAD maximum chunk duration; omitted inherits the session duration. Fixed/long_form windows use the session setting, not this request override.

request.name: hotwords
request.description: Optional native vocabulary bias: comma-separated terms or a JSON list; up to 25 terms.

request.name: hotwords_score
request.description: Phonon-2/Bark native matching-piece logit bonus; duration scores and blank are not biased.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Shared matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: matmul_weight_type
session.description: Encoder and decoder matmul weight storage type; defaults to weight_type, which defaults to native. Q8_0 measured 1.79x faster on the tested CPU and changed roughly 8 percent of transcripts without moving aggregate word error rate.

session.name: conv_weight_type
session.description: Convolution weight storage type; default native.

session.name: perf_mode
session.description: Encoder attention implementation. Default off uses the validated relative-attention path; flash_attention enables the fused implementation, which was numerically validated but slower on the tested hardware.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: Weight context arena size in MiB; default 3072.

session.name: encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Encoder graph arena size in MiB; default 1024.

session.name: decoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Decoder graph arena size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
session.description: Center-region duration for buffered streaming in seconds; default 2. Fixed context windows are re-encoded rather than cache-aware. Also sizes offline fixed/long_form windows.

session.name: left_context_sec
session.description: Past context included when re-encoding each buffered-streaming window in seconds; default 10. Also applies to offline fixed/long_form windows.

session.name: right_context_sec
session.description: Future lookahead included when re-encoding each buffered-streaming window in seconds; default 2 and adds equivalent partial-result latency. Also applies to offline fixed/long_form windows.

session.name: streaming_attention_mode
session.description: Attention policy inside each buffered window. full_context preserves bidirectional attention over the bounded window.

session.name: offline_mode
session.description: Offline encoder scheduling. full_context encodes the whole utterance, long_form uses bounded overlapping windows, and auto selects long_form beyond audio_chunk_threshold_sec.

session.name: audio_chunk_threshold_sec
session.description: Duration threshold used by offline_mode=auto before switching to bounded-window long-form execution; default 30 seconds.

session.name: vad_model_path
session.description: VAD model path used by audio_chunk_mode=vad (any built-in VAD family); default assets/framework/models/silero_vad.
